SELECT h.journal_header_id, h.journal_no, h.journal_date, h.journal_type, h.source_entity_type, h.source_entity_id, h.contract_id, c.contract_no AS contractNo, h.status, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.debit_amount), 0) FROM fgc.journal_line l WHERE l.journal_header_id = h.journal_header_id) AS debitTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.credit_amount), 0) FROM fgc.journal_line l WHERE l.journal_header_id = h.journal_header_id) AS creditTotal, h.reversal_of_id AS reversalOfId, rev.journal_no AS reversalOfJournalNo, creator.login_id AS createdBy, poster.login_id AS postedBy, h.posted_at AS postedAt, h.created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.journal_header h LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = h.contract_id LEFT JOIN fgc.journal_header rev ON rev.journal_header_id = h.reversal_of_id LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user creator ON creator.user_id = h.created_by LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user poster ON poster.user_id = h.posted_by
ORDER BY h.journal_date DESC, h.journal_header_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
